claimed_title: Executive Order 5461—Power-Site Restoration No. 451, Solomon Creek and Uno Creek, Alaska
text:
Executive Order 5461. October 14, 1930
Executive Order
Power-Site Restoration No. 451, Solomon Greek and Uno
Creek, Alaska
So much of the order of July 31, 1915, creating Power-Site Keserve No. 491, as
affects lands hereinafter described is hereby revoked:
All lands within one-quarter of a mile of the stream flowing in Solomon Gulch
between the point of discharge of said stream into Port Valdez at mean high tide,
and a point 2 miles upstream from said point of discharge; except such lands as are
included in Project No. 1101 as defined by the Federal Power Commission in a
notice to the General Land Office dated J\me 25, 1930;
All lands within one-quarter of a mile of Uno Creek between its point of discharge
into Shoup Bay, an arm of Port Valdez, at mean high tide, and a point l}i miles
upstream from said point of discharge.
HERBERT HOOVER
The White House,
October 14, 1930,
[No. 5461]
